 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.
2. The Petitioner in this writ application seeks for a higher compensation for acquisition of his land for expansion of the National Highway.

3. In course of hearing, Mr. Purna Chandra Mishra, learned counsel for the Petitioner prays for withdrawal of the writ petition to avail the remedy under Section 3 (G) (5) of the National Highways Act, 1956 for enhancement of compensation.
4. Hence, the writ petition is disposed of as withdrawn with an observation that the Petitioner, if so advised, may work out remedy, if any, available under law.
Urgent certified copy of this order be granted on proper application.
(K.R. Mohapatra) Judge Digitally Signed (Savitri Ratho) Signed by: PUSPANJALI MOHAPATRA
